name: unity-launchpad
title: Unity Launchpad
description: List the unity projects and launch them directly from raycast
author: onebaney

preferences.name: projectPaths
preferences.title: Project Paths
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of folders containing Unity projects (e.g., ~/UnityProjects, ~/Documents/Projects)

preferences.name: enginePaths
preferences.title: Unity Engine Paths
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of Unity Editor installation paths (e.g., /Applications/Unity/Hub/Editor, C:\Program Files\Unity\Hub\Editor)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
